code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int =>
    if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

lcm(a: int, b: int) -> int =>
    if a == 0 \/ b == 0 then
        0
    else
        Math.abs(a / gcd(a, b) * b)
    fi

for (a, b) in [(12, 18), (-6, 14), (35, 0)] do
    write_line("lcm({a}, {b}) = {lcm(a, b)}")
od

use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int =>
    if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

lcm(a: int, b: int) -> int =>
    if a == 0 \/ b == 0 then
        0
    else
        Math.abs(a / gcd(a, b) * b)
    fi

for (a, b) in [(12, 18), (-6, 14), (35, 0)] do
    write_line("lcm({a}, {b}) = {lcm(a, b)}")
od
